name: msdoc_extract_text
description:
Extracts plain text from a Word (.docx) or Excel (.xlsx/.xlsm) file. Word: paragraphs joined by newlines (tables left out). Excel: the active sheet only, first 10000 rows, one line per row with tab-separated cells. Files are looked up by name in the docs folder (data/msdocs; msdoc_list_files shows it). Word files need python-docx.
Returns {filename, text, character_count}.
Inputs (* required): filename*.
For structure (tables, sheets, cells) use msdoc_read_word or msdoc_read_excel.
Example: {"filename": "report.docx"}

filename.description: Name of the file to extract text from (Word or Excel)
